name: Tornado Kick (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Improved Unarmed Strike, Tae Kwon Do, Dex 15, Acrobatics 6 ranks or BAB +6

Benefit(s): When using this style and making one unarmed attack as a standard action, if the first attack is successful you may make one additional unarmed attack against another creature within your reach at the same attack bonus.

Bonuses that only apply to one attack (Such as that from Dazzling Display or Vital Strike) do not apply to this extra attack.

Special: A monk may add this feat to the list of monk feats he may select from at 6th level and higher.
